name: MemGround
description: Current evaluations of long-term memory in LLMs are fundamentally static. By fixating on simple retrieval and short-context inference, they neglect the multifaceted nature of complex memory systems, such as dynamic state tracking and hierarchical reasoning in continuous interactions. To overcome these limitations, we propose MemGround, a rigorous long-term memory benchmark natively grounded in rich, gamified interactive scenarios.
